scope_note: Uses only the K143272 FDA PDF. Predicate columns are used only as limiting or contrasting evidence. No manufacturer labeling, predicate documents, or general device knowledge.

legacy_assessments.note: Verbatim match with the 510(k) Summary Intended Use section. The same text appears on the image-only Form FDA 3881 (p. 3), available only as local OCR.

evidence.quote: The ApneaLink™ Air device is indicated for use by Health Care Professionals (HCP), where it may aid in the diagnosis of sleep disordered breathing for adult patients. ApneaLink Air records the following data: patient respiratory nasal airflow, snoring, blood oxygen saturation, pulse, respiratory effort and body position during sleep. The device uses these recordings to produce a report for the HCP that may aid in the diagnosis of sleep disordered breathing or for further clinical investigation. The device is intended for home and hospital use under the direction of a HCP.
ApneaLink Air records the following data: patient respiratory nasal airflow, snoring, blood oxygen saturation, pulse, respiratory effort and body position during sleep.
